entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 2:1 landscape reveal-background illustration for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens campaign, mission Soft crossing.
Primary request: a botanical radio observatory after rain. A broad translucent seed vessel suspended over a rain basin, slightly right of center, with a small copper tuning instrument toward the left. The lower area is broad, quiet slate-blue water. Distant quiet antenna structures and soft greenhouse atmosphere establish a distinctive scientific garden.
Style/medium: sophisticated hand-painted environmental illustration, convincing materials and gentle depth, composed large shapes, restrained detail, no pixel grid or board diagram.
Color palette: slate-blue ceramic, warm aged copper, muted silver-green botanical leaves, atmospheric rain light.
Composition: panoramic 2:1, one legible large subject plus the smaller instrument discovery separated across the frame; interesting details revealed progressively, generous low-detail water and atmospheric glass. Edge fragments should remain beautiful. No frame.
Constraints: original art, no UI, no letters or text, no logos, no watermarks, no people or game characters. No bright narrow neon lines, tiny repeated dots, warning crosses, enemy-like specks, or literal horizontal obstacle stripe. Artwork must not imply collision geometry or safe routes. Generate a single composition, not a collage.

Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: original modern pixel-art2:1 reveal background for the Xonix-style game Reveal Line, mission Soft crossing.
Edit target: supplied Soft crossing botanical radio observatory composition. Preserve major composition: large translucent seed vessel suspended right of center over broad water, small copper tuning instrument left, distant glass conservatories and dishes, quiet water lower half. Preserve landscape2:1 and the separate discoveries; no added characters/props/UI.
Change only visual treatment: deliberately authored modern pixel art with confident visible pixel clusters, clean stepped silhouettes, economical roughly32–48-color slate-blue/copper/silver-green palette, well grouped light and shadow, subtle controlled dithering only where useful. Repaint forms as designed pixel clusters, NOT a pixelation filter, nearest-neighbor resize of a painting or blurred low-resolution photo. Reduce foliage into readable shape groups and glass glare into a few muted clusters. Clear large forms at small game-board size, restrained luminance peaks to keep bright actors/trails readable. No smooth airbrushed gradients, photorealistic raindrops, lens blur, tiny sparkles or noisy texture. No text/logo/watermark/grid/border. A polished pixel-art game illustration, not a board diagram.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 2:1 panoramic reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Dry spine.
Primary request: botanical radio observatory after rain; a tall ribbed slate-blue ceramic greenhouse chimney at the left third, with a curled silver-green leaf and seed tray toward the right. Pale atmospheric glass behind and distant quiet antenna structures. Make the chimney a distinctive sculptural garden object, not a factory smokestack; no smoke.
Style: composed hand-painted environmental illustration, believable weathered ceramic and warm copper details, broad readable shapes, restrained detail, soft rain daylight, calm slate blue and silver green. Two focal discoveries well separated across the frame, subtle generous negative space. Panoramic2:1, full bleed.
Constraints: entirely original illustration, no game UI, no text, logos or watermark; no people or game actors. No symmetrical central dividing line, no board/grid diagram, no literal gameplay foundations. Avoid thin neon strokes, tiny repeated bright dots, warning crosses or enemy-like specks. It is a rewarding picture, not map geometry. One composition, no collage.

Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: modern pixel-art2:1 reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Dry spine.
Edit target supplied composition: retain tall ribbed blue ceramic greenhouse chimney at left third, curled silver-green leaf and seed tray right, distant glasshouses and quiet radio dishes across misty garden. Same major proportions/locations, landscape2:1.
Repaint visual treatment into deliberately authored modern pixel art: strong visible clusters, clean stepped silhouettes, limited coordinated slate-blue/copper/silver-green color groups, broad light/shadow planes and quiet sky. No pixelation filter, photorealism or nearest-neighbor resized photo. Simplify busy foliage/seed details into readable grouped shapes. Keep highlights muted so real bright gameplay actors/trails can overlay it. No blur, photographic raindrops or tiny bright speckle noise, no UI/text/logo/watermark/border. Original scene only; no new props/characters. Preserve recognizability at small board size and retain composition as a separate pixel-art revision.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original panoramic2:1 reveal-background illustration for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Wide approach.
Primary request: two distinct glass conservatories across a deep reflecting botanical radio garden after rain: a near angular greenhouse and a distant rounded conservatory. A folded warm copper canopy in the lower left gives a small second discovery; broad misty low-detail water separates the structures. Quiet antenna structures in the distance, soft silver-green reeds and slate-blue ceramic garden fittings.
Style: polished hand-painted environmental illustration with believable materials, broad composed shapes and gentle atmospheric depth. Same coherent slate-blue, aged-copper, silver-green garden identity, but a distinct open, spacious water composition. No dominant seed vessel or chimney. Panoramic2:1fullbleed.
Constraints: do not mirror the pavilions, no apparent traversable bridge between them. Original art only; no game UI, labels, logos, watermark, people or game characters. No neon lines, warning crosses, tiny repeating bright specks, grid or map diagram. Revealing this picture rewards discovery but must not promise gameplay routes. One composition, not a collage.

Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: modern pixel-art panoramic2:1 reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Wide approach.
Edit target: supplied original two-conservatory scene. Preserve its near angular glasshouses and folded copper canopy on left, distant rounded glass conservatory right, broad quiet reflecting water between, slate-blue garden pots and silver-green reeds. Do not add a bridge between the two sides.
Change visual treatment only into consciously authored contemporary pixel art: confident visible clusters, stepped silhouettes, grouped limited palette of slate blue, muted green and aged copper, clearly separated large shapes. Simplify greenhouse bars and foliage into clean readable forms. Broad quiet water, restrained pale reflections, no sparkling single-pixel noise. Preserve exact major composition, atmospheric depth and two distinctive discoveries. Repaint, do not use a pixelation/nearest-neighbor photo filter. No photographic blur, smooth airbrush gradients, text, UI, logos, watermark or frame. One illustration, not a board map.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original modern pixel-art2:1 panoramic reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Cool the crossing.
Scene: botanical radio observatory after rain, close view of a weathered copper irrigation wheel slightly right of center, large sculptural curved vanes and droplets represented as a few restrained pixel clusters. On the opposite left foreground a blue ceramic bowl with fresh silver-green shoots, spacious soft wet slate stone behind. A distant glasshouse and subtle quiet radio antenna suggest the same botanical science garden. No large water vista, no chimney: this composition is intimate and material-focused.
Style: deliberately authored modern pixel art, clearly visible purposeful pixel clusters and stepped edges, limited harmonized slate-blue/aged-copper/silver-green palette, broad legible light/shadow planes, restrained texture, atmospheric depth without photographic blur. Warm gentle side light; no glowing warning-red areas. Quiet regions between focal discoveries, clear recognizable primary wheel and secondary shoots, panoramic2:1 full bleed.
Constraints: original illustration, no game UI/text/logo/watermark/people, no fire or red warning signs, no framed crosses, no grid or board geometry, no apparent navigable paths. No neon strokes, tiny sparkles or noisy photographic textures. A sophisticated pixel-art reward scene, not a pixelated photograph or overhead map.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original modern pixel-art panoramic 2:1 reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Garden refuges.
Scene: a botanical radio observatory after rain. Layered hanging garden with large rounded slate-blue ceramic planters suspended at several depths, their broad silver-green leaves forming distinct sculptural clusters. An open aged-copper seed cabinet partly visible at one side provides the secondary discovery. Quiet misty glasshouse panes and soft blue sky between planters, subtle distant radio instrumentation. A sheltered elevated garden, not a water vista or wheel scene.
Style: purposefully authored modern pixel art with confident visible pixel clusters, clean stepped outlines, broad grouped light/shadow planes, restrained slate-blue/copper/silver-green palette. Readable large shapes at a small game-board size, atmospheric depth without photographic blur. Muted highlights and quiet negative space, no noise or sparkling dots.
Composition: panoramic 2:1 full bleed, asymmetric hanging planters and separately discoverable cabinet, no thin repeated vertical bars or dangling bright threads that could compete with an active trail.
Constraints: original scene, no people, avatars, UI, text, logo, watermark, grid, map geometry, neon lines, warning crosses or apparent playable lanes. Repainted pixel-art forms, not pixelated photography.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original modern pixel-art panoramic 2:1 reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens mission Neutral ground.
Scene: an asymmetric circular rain pavilion in a botanical radio observatory after rain. The broad aged-copper rounded roof is off-center and one large folded silver-green leaf fills part of the foreground. A small brass radio receiver tucked under the eave is the second discovery. Spacious slate-blue reflections occupy the rest, with quiet ceramic garden details and distant misty glasshouses. No cross-shaped walkway, no bridge or implied gameplay route.
Style: visibly designed modern pixel art, confident blocky pixel clusters and stepped contours, broad flat shaded planes, economical harmonious slate blue/aged copper/silver green. Large readable shapes and purposeful controlled detail, no smooth painting, no photographic noise or tiny sparkle highlights. Think a high-quality hand-authored pixel game environment with calm areas behind functional game overlays.
Composition: panoramic 2:1 full bleed, rounded pavilion silhouette contrasts with the large folded leaf; separated discoveries; muted bright areas for overlay clarity.
Constraints: original artwork only, no people, game actors, text, UI, logos, watermark, neon strokes, warning crosses, grid or map diagram. No photorealism or pixelation filter.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original modern pixel-art panoramic 2:1 reveal background for Reveal Line, Signal Gardens optional finale Winding channels.
Scene: sweeping reed conservatory beneath a broad arched aged-copper roof at dusk, viewed obliquely across quiet slate-blue water. Three large and differently shaped seed lanterns (round glass vessel, faceted ceramic vessel, elongated glass vessel) are distributed asymmetrically across the composition, their interiors softly warm rather than bright dots. Silver-green reed clusters form wide graceful masses; soft distant radio dishes place this in a botanical observatory. Calm dark water near the edges makes narrow reveals rewarding.
Style: deliberately drawn modern pixel art with clearly visible confident pixel clusters and stepped contours, broad shaded planes, tightly coordinated slate-blue/aged-copper/silver-green palette with muted warm lantern cores. No photographic smoothness, airbrushing, noisy detail or pixelation filter. Sophisticated pixel-game environment, readable at small board size.
Composition: panoramic2:1 full bleed, the arched roof and reed sweep provide the primary large silhouette, three different seed vessels reward successive discoveries without mirroring game islands. No diagram or overhead map.
Constraints: original art, no people, game actors, UI, text, logos, watermark, neon lines, warning symbols, dense sparkles or tiny enemy-like lights. No literal route lanes or promise of safe ground.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original modern pixel-art panoramic2:1 background for Reveal Line Signal Gardens Team mission Shared detour.
Scene: botanical radio observatory after rain. A close sculptural slate-blue ceramic seed bench with broad seed trays on one side; a distant glass refuge with an aged-copper roof on the other, deliberately unequal in scale. Two different rain vessels, a squat ribbed blue bowl nearby and a slender glass collector far away, relate through the garden view without a literal connecting lane. Broad grouped silver-green leaves frame spacious soft mist and calm reflections; subtle radio dishes in the distance.
Style: modern hand-authored pixel art, confident clearly visible stepped contours and purposeful pixel clusters, grouped light/shadow planes and limited coherent slate-blue/copper/silver-green palette. Calm large forms readable beneath bright game overlays, restrained highlights, quiet negative space. Not a smooth painting, pixelated photograph or noisy texture.
Composition: panoramic2:1 full bleed, strong near/far asymmetry invites complementary discoveries, not duplicate halves. It is a rewarding scene, not a map. Different primary bench silhouette from previous seed vessel, chimney, wheel and pavilion pictures.
Constraints: original artwork, no avatars/people/UI/text/logo/watermark, no arrows, hazard crosses, neon paths, bright tiny specks, literal gameplay lanes or mirrored partner roles.
